prompt: If you have a tool for asking the user a question (request_user_input or similar), use it to ask which colour I prefer, Red or Blue, then reply with the colour. If you have no such tool, reply exactly: NO QUESTION TOOL.
capturedOn: local codex app-server probe (thread/start ephemeral, read-only)
notes: Codex asks with request_user_input_async (an agentMessage delivered async, its full text at item/started, no deltas) and waits inside the same turn with clock.sleep. 4 s later the answer goes as a mid-turn turn/start, which Codex takes into the running turn: the response names the same turn (inProgress), the sleep ends early, a userMessage item opens in that turn, the agent answers and the turn completes. Account, rate-limit and remote-control notifications are left out; the cwd is redacted.
